thread:
anna: Quick recap from today's all-hands: Optimize v1 launched to beta partners, we tightened data retention policy (see legal note), and execs answered Qs about pricing & SLAs. Recording + action items below.

rachel: Slides + demo assets here: https://drive.redwood/company/allhands/2112256789-optimize-v1-slides.pdf. Demo clip on slide 5 shows token-level cost savings.

deploy_bot: Recording available: https://redwood.cloud/recordings/2112256789-allhands.mp4 (auto-captions attached). Transcript: https://redwood.cloud/transcripts/2112256789.txt

jules: quick q on the retention change 1: does this affect logs stored for 30 days for observability? legal said retention decreased to 14 days for non-PII by default.

ben: short answer: observability traces remain 30d by default; user content retention changed to 14d unless customer opts in via contract. legal posted details in the policy doc: https://docs.redwood/company/policies/data-retention-v2.md

tim: great launch. for Dedicated customers, what's the earliest ETA for autoscale in GA? slide 9 had "H2" but would like a narrower window.

anna: autoscale GA targeted Q3 end. we'll publish a more specific calendar after the Dedicated roadmap sync next Monday.

maya: marketing ask: can someone draft a 3-bullet public summary we can use for the blog and social? I can turn into a draft thread.

rachel: draft bullets: 1) Optimize v1 reduces per-token cost via adaptive batching and cache reuse; 2) Beta available to select partners next week; 3) New data retention defaults and enhanced compliance controls.

jules: thanks. also pinging legal here to confirm regional variance for EU customers.

ben: legal: confirmed EU customers can opt for region-locking + extended retention in contract. will follow up with clause text by EOD.

anna: action items: 1) maya to post blog draft by Tue (owner @maya); 2) product to publish Dedicated autoscale ETA after roadmap sync (owner @anna); 3) ops to share SLO templates and oncall playbook (owner @rachel). Please add anything I missed in the follow-ups doc.

deploy_bot: Follow-ups doc created: https://docs.redwood/company/allhands/2112256789-followups. Owners and deadlines added.

tim: can we have a short postmortem-style note for the demo hiccup (audio drop at 21:15)? small thing but useful to avoid repeat.

rachel: noted 1 121: we had a transient mic mute during the demo. ops/devex will add a pre-demo checklist.

maya: posting marketing thread now and tagging design for hero artwork.

anna: thanks all. if you raised a question in the Q&A appendix of the slides and need a follow-up, drop it in the follow-ups doc or DM me. We'll do a 10-min update in #product next Wednesday with the Dedicated timeline.

jules: :thumbsup: appreciate the clear notes.

ben: added legal clause draft to the follow-ups doc.

rachel: closing the loop: added SLO template skeleton to the follow-ups doc (objective, metric, alert thresholds, warm fallback, escalation contacts). Feedback welcome.

anna: perfect. meeting closed 1 and thanks again for the fast turnaround on all the follow-ups.
